plan.purpose: Next bounded physical local-response identification after formal0/100 and failed goal-residual gain grid; no PPO training or hardware
plan.physical_preparation: Each case independently performs the original real reach/manual release/frozen7s grasp; exact prefix physical/controller/camera/RNG/model signature required; failed prefix counts and is never resampled
plan.base_action: Frozen100k actor with only active goal matrices replaced by measured prefix-end orientation; unvalidated neutral-goal diagnostic reference
plan.probes: One reference plus +/- pulse on each of16 motor action channels:33 physically integrated cases
plan.fit_scales: Translation per1mm, rotation per1deg; ridge0.1; bounded residual action +/-0.04
plan.validation_admission: One candidate only if predicted fullSO3 error relative to2deg world-Z target<0.5deg and translation from prefix end<1mm; otherwise skip without changing amplitude or target
plan.censored_pairs: Keep all aborts and failed prefixes in raw results; only pairs completing identical0.5s without failure enter the local fit, other motor residuals fixed0
plan.measurement: World rotation vector and position relative to reference at the same physical time; record actual commands/joints, forces and contact bodies. Simulator truth is scoring/identification only, never an actor input
plan.fit: Central finite differences estimate local residual-action to6D object-motion response, including physical delays, motor coupling and contacts; do not assume a rigid sticking grasp or treat analytic motor Jacobians as passive-joint-aware
plan.one_optional_validation: If the bounded local fit supports it, solve one minimum-norm action residual within +/-0.04 per channel for2deg world-Z motion and zero off-axis/translation, then physically test that one candidate from the identical independently executed prefix
plan.constraints: Original action clipping,0.8rad/s velocity,2rad/s^2 acceleration, ROM, all2ms force/penetration/excluded-support and release-origin displacement audits; every abort retained
plan.unchanged_physics: No friction/contact-dimension/solver tuning, pose injection, velocity clearing or reset to a successful simulator snapshot
plan.scope: Local0.5s control-authority measurement only; not the7s rotation task or acceptance. No formal2611 reuse, no trained-policy relabeling
